DIWA
**Genre:** Epic Fantasy | Adventure | Philippine Mythology | Coming-of-Age

Hi everyone!

After carrying this idea with me since my high school days, I finally decided it was time to bring it to life. After my 25th birthday, I rebuilt the project from the ground up—reimagining its world, story, characters, and illustrations into the version I'd always envisioned.

**Blurb:**

Journey alongside **Pang**, a young boy growing up in an archipelago inspired by pre-colonial Philippines, divided among four great realms and powerful rival clans.

What begins as a simple desire to earn his father's approval soon becomes a journey far greater than he ever imagined. Along the way, Pang must navigate friendship and family, courage and sacrifice, as ancient traditions, forgotten legends, and the fate of the realms slowly intertwine.

Blending Filipino mythology, adventure, and coming-of-age fantasy, **DIWA** is a story about love, loss, identity, acceptance, and belonging—and perhaps, a reminder of what the Bayanihan spirit truly means.

This is my debut novel, and I'd genuinely appreciate any feedback on the writing, pacing, worldbuilding, or characters. Thanks for taking the time to check it out!

Here are my best web novels where our MC is a God from chapter 1

**1. Cuthulu Gonfalon - The Jellyfish God (OP MC, No system administrator, Fantasy, No Cultivation) \[C\]**

Cthulhu Gonfalon is a story about a man who woke up in another world. After a drink over his loss in a game, Sui Xiong ended up in the middle of the sea. Surprisingly, he now found out he no longer existed in a human shape but in a spirit state without any flesh. In order to survive and find a way to return to Earth, he then searched for a body to accommodate his spirit. After several confrontations with some creatures under the sea, he decided to settle for a jellyfish flesh. This Jellyfish was extraordinarily huge. With its tentacles, it caught others’ spirits to nurture its own power. In this world, Sui Xiong wasn’t only matchlessly powerful but he also had an ability to cast magic. With this gifted ability and combined with his knowledge from the civilized world on Earth, he could help a deceased person resurrect, change a person’s look, and do tons of other crazy things that he didn’t know.

As his journey to discover this world went on, he encountered many bizarre and mystic creatures along the way, who were Gods, Humans, Devil Beasts, Giant Dragons and lots of other undetermined organisms. Some of them might insanely worship him, while others hated him. Some might become his enemies. Some might end up becoming his teammates in the end. From a gamer on Earth to here, he became a God (even he himself could not verify this yet), had his own religion and even a church with a Holy Land to fight for justice.

What kind of world is this? What kind of existences might live in this world? What kind of secret this world owns? Can Sui Xiong return to Earth?

He (yes, He) now must rely on players from the blue planet to help his goal of reviving the past glory of the elves and the World Tree.

From this point on, the number of races in the Otherworld became more plentiful. His territory was orderly and clean, with incredible cuisine, countless novelties, and civilization and philosophy ahead of the whole world.

On Earth, his existence caused the rebirth of magic and mythology, allowing him to become the only God.

“I am the Golden King, the Giver of Life, the Champion of Magic, the Weaver of Dreams, the Guardian of the World, the Master of Time. Let mortals bow down before me and look up! Let the Gods tremble in fear before me!”

**5. The Soul of Negary - The Germ God (OP MC, No System Administrator, Fantasy) \[C\]**

Heed my call! O’ Dragon of Eternal Sin, the Progressive Disaster, the Forerunner, the Land of Eternal Peace, the Flames of Soul Burning, He Who Owns The Deep Soul, the Sound of Origin, the First Cause of All Things, the Principle of Circles… o’ great Negary, your servant calls for your return!

**6. I, am God? - The True Creator (OP MC, Fantasy, System Administrator, Cultivation) \[IP\]**

Matthias died and became something that he least expected.

”I.. Am God?“

Join Matthias as he travel through galaxies and create all things.

–––––––––––––––––

What would you do if you suddenly gained a power that no mortal man could hope to achieve?

What would you do if all creation suddenly bowed to your power and glory that only lofty Emperors could have?

{A Runaway Noble in a Town of Lonely Wives}
I'd love some thoughts and reviews on my fantasy romance novel. It's free on both scribblehub and webnovel 

Callis Vale ran away from a gilded cage to become a frontier hero. The frontier answered by beating him half to death in the mud.

Hartsgate is a brutal trade town on the edge of the Green March, a place that survives by turning danger into coin. It has no use for noble blood, polished manners, or expensive education. Out here, a young man who can’t hold a spear, read a contract, or survive the road is just another future casualty.

Broke, freezing, and dangerously out of his depth, Callis survives his first days not through talent or destiny, but through the women who actually keep Hartsgate alive: the innkeeper whose husband drinks away the profits, the armorer whose skill is treated like a commodity, the clerks, traders, and widows who hold the town together while the men around them rot, rage, or die.

At first, their attention buys him only what he needs most: shelter, food, advice, and a reason to keep going. But in a town built on interlocking systems, intimacy is never just intimacy. Every bed hides a secret. Every marriage conceals a fracture. Every woman Callis wins trust from gives him access to another corner of Hartsgate’s real power.

What begins as survival turns into something far more dangerous. Callis is no longer just winning the desire of lonely wives—he is building a network inside the town’s kitchens, forges, shrines, and counting rooms. And as the monsters of the Elderforest press closer and suspicious husbands begin to notice, the web keeping him alive may be the same one that gets him killed.

A spicy adult frontier fantasy harem romance with explicit scenes, dangerous women, and a plot that bites back.

Foresight [LitRPG / Progression Fantasy]
Hey everyone! Here's the comedic LitRPG story I've poured my heart, soul, and fragile sense of self into for the last couple of months. Please check it out if it interests you at all (any and all critique welcome), and let me know what you think of the cover! I commissioned my artist friend to make it, and I kinda adore it.

[Foresight](https://www.royalroad.com/fiction/190128/foresight-litrpg-progression-fantasy)

On his Coming of Age day, Corin Vess was appraised with 'Foresight', an {Epic} Innate Ability - and it was an epic failure. Really, the only punch he ever accurately foresaw was becoming a punchline: the Guild's biggest joke, the F-rank adventurer with an Epic ability that did absolutely nothing, two years running (and no doubt counting).

Then one day, he inexplicably receives a vision of the Turn - the world's weekly small-to-catastrophic changes - before it happens. Turns out his Innate was never about predicting combat at all - it was about seeing into exactly where he wasn't supposed to. Corin is forced to act fast to exploit the visions, all the while trying to keep his power a secret from those around him, and whatever's looming above him.
